name: Dhamma Suriya
aka: Centro de Meditacion Vipassana Dhamma Suriya
tradition: Vipassana Meditation as taught by S.N. Goenka
technique: Anapana and Vipassana body-scan meditation, taught in silent, structured residential courses
teacherAccess: No individual teacher access; courses are led by certified Goenka-tradition assistant teachers who give recorded (audio/video) evening discourses and are available for brief questions.
retreatOptions: 10-day courses (the standard offering, held several times a year on a published calendar); a longer 14-day Gratitude course for qualified old students; and periodic childrens/teen courses.
about: Dhamma Suriya is Peru's dedicated center for the worldwide Goenka/dhamma.org Vipassana network, built on a desert property on the Cieneguilla/Pachacamac outskirts of Lima. It was constructed largely through community bioconstruction, with volunteer natural-builders and architects who are themselves Vipassana students raising earth-built dormitories and a meditation hall on the site. The center runs the standard 10-day residential Vipassana course several times a year on a published calendar, alongside a longer 14-day Gratitude course for qualified returning students and periodic courses for children and teenagers. As with all centers in the Goenka tradition, courses are held under Noble Silence on a fixed daily schedule, taught in Spanish (often with English support), and offered entirely free of charge, funded solely by voluntary donations from past students. Meals and dormitory-style lodging are provided on-site for the full duration of each course.
schedule: 10-day courses held several times a year at the centers own site in Cieneguilla/Pachacamac (Lima), announced on the dhamma.org Peru course calendar, plus periodic 14-day old-student and childrens/teen courses.
cost: No fees of any kind; entirely dana (voluntary donation)-based, with all teaching, food, and lodging given freely and funded by donations from past students who completed a course.

pricePerDay.notes: No suggested amount; official Goenka tradition (dhamma.org) center with no set course fee.

foodNotes: All meals prepared and served on-site at no charge for the duration of each course; vegetarian meals included.
workNotes: Old students (those who have completed at least one prior 10-day course) are asked to give some work service (dhamma seva) during their stay; new students are generally not required to work.
